diagnosis: CSPPolicyBreakdownView aggregates Content Security Policy violations for any policy_id without confirming that the policy belongs to the requesting tenant. An attacker can map blocked origins and active directives of competitor tenants to identify third-party dependencies and potential injection points.
exploit_request:
GET /api/csp/policies/184/breakdown/ HTTP/1.1
Host: secops.tenantcloud.com
Authorization: Token tenant_analyst_jwt
Accept: application/json
